Data.subject: Resident Households
Data.title: Resident Households By Household Size And Floor Area Of Residence, Annual
Data.footnote: If there are more than one resident household living in a dwelling unit, each household will be counted once in the data. Data exclude households without floor area information. Data for 2020 are based on the Census of Population while data for 2015 and 2025 are based on the General Household Survey.  Data for all other years are based on the Comprehensive June Labour Force Survey.  Survey estimates are subject to sampling variability.
